proposals.before: He first served in the Yangtze River navy, joined Liu Mingchuan in suppressing the Nian rebels, and rose through merit to adjutant.
proposals.after: He first served in the Yangtze River navy, joined Liu Mingchuan in suppressing the Nian rebels, and rose through merit to assistant brigade commander (canjiang).
proposals.reason: Qing 參將 is a mid-rank combat command grade (assistant brigade commander), not an adjutant staff post.

proposals.before: At first he belonged to the Yangtze naval force; following Liu Mingchuan against the Nian, he accumulated merit until made adjutant.
proposals.after: At first he belonged to the Yangtze naval force; following Liu Mingchuan against the Nian, he accumulated merit until made assistant brigade commander (canjiang).

decisions.reason: s0004 ends 積勳至參將. Qing 參將 is a Green Standard mid-rank combat command grade (canjiang), not a staff adjutant; the proposed replacement restores that rank without adding or omitting content.
The same focus phrase 積勳至參將 is mistranslated as 'adjutant' in the literal field; 'assistant brigade commander (canjiang)' correctly renders the combat rank.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0001 shows the English office label 'adjutant-general (canjiang)' came from mistranslating 參將 as an adjutant post; the office fact remains, but the English label must read assistant brigade commander (canjiang).
